local: Saved on this device. Sending is not connected yet.
queued: Saved on this device. Your submitted feedback is waiting for confirmation.
synced: Your submitted feedback was received by the playtest team.
draftSaved: Draft saved on this device. Press Send to share it.
failed: Your submitted feedback could not be sent. You can try Send again.
retrying: Your submitted feedback could not be sent. A limited retry is scheduled while this page stays open.
storage: This browser cannot save feedback reliably. Keep this page open and download Excel before leaving. A new player cannot start until saving works.
recovery: Some earlier feedback could not be reopened. The original is kept for your instructor to recover.
changed: A new player started in another tab. Reloading to keep players separate.
empty: Your saved comments will appear here.
newConfirm: Start a new anonymous player? The next person gets fresh game progress and score sharing starts off. Your local drafts stay on this device, but the next player will not see them.
downloadError: Excel could not be downloaded. Keep this page open and try again.
removed: We removed things that look like contact details. Please check the preview and remove any names.
hold: Ask a grown-up to press and hold for 2 seconds to send
holdCancel: Nothing sent. Hold for 2 seconds when ready.
unavailable: Sending is not connected. Your draft stays on this device.
scoresOnly: Score sharing is off unless a grown-up turns it on.
title: Playtest feedback
introduction: Tell us what you notice while you play. You can leave a separate note for each stop.
privacyLocal: Your draft and saved notes stay on this device. Download an Excel backup before clearing browser data. No name or contact details are needed.
privacyCloud: Drafts stay on this device. Ask a grown-up to review and send a note to the playtest team. Sending includes the selected stop, language and a random player code. Scores are included only with permission. Never include names or contact details.
hint: A few words are enough. Please leave out names, email addresses and other personal details.
shared: Sharing this computer? Choose New player before someone else plays. It starts a separate game and feedback session.
